This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals.

programme.title: Serena
programme.desc: Après près de 20 ans passés à surmonter les obstacles et à jouer dans l'ombre de sa soeur aînée, Venus Williams, Serena Williams remporte à 17 ans son premier titre du Grand Chelem lors de l'US Open de 1999.

programme.title: Serena
programme.desc: Alors que Serena peine à enchaîner après son premier titre du Grand Chelem, Venus remporte quatre titres majeurs en deux ans; Serena finit par trouver son rythme, mais cela implique d'affronter la meilleure joueuse du monde: sa soeur.

programme.title: Serena
programme.desc: Après la mort tragique de sa demi-soeur, Yetunde Price, Serena est accablée par le chagrin et la dépression, ce qui la fait sortir du top 100 du classement; Serena participe à l'Open d'Australie en 2007.

programme.title: Serena
programme.desc: Se sentant seule sur le court, Serena cherche à améliorer son jeu avec l'aide d'une nouvelle équipe ; après avoir repris la première place du classement, l'équipe de Serena doit se rallier autour d'elle suite à des problèmes de santé.

programme.desc: Après avoir perdu dès le premier tour d'un tournoi du Grand Chelem pour la première fois de sa carrière, Serena engage un nouvel entraîneur, Patrick Mouratoglou. Serena revient sur le parcours similaire qu'a suivi son ami Roger Federer.

programme.title: Serena
programme.desc: Serena fait son grand retour à Indian Wells, un tournoi empreint de souvenirs douloureux pour sa famille; Serena, ses soeurs et Mary Joe Fernández reviennent sur l'événement qui a conduit Serena à boycotter le tournoi d'Indiana Wells pendant 14 ans.

programme.title: Serena
programme.desc: À l'Open d'Italie, l'amour marque des points lorsque Serena rencontre Alexis Ohanian; juste après ses fiançailles, Serena aborde l'Open d'Australie avec l'espoir de remporter son 23e titre du Grand Chelem, tout en cachant un secret.

programme.title: Serena
programme.desc: Alors qu'elle entame un nouveau chapitre de sa vie, Serena se dirige vers la fin de sa carrière; après avoir donné naissance à sa fille Olympia, Serena retourne sur les courts avant d'annoncer sa retraite juste avant l'US Open de 2022.

programme.desc: The Mystery Inc. team must save Coolsville from all of their past monsters when they are brought back to life by a masked man trying to take down the gang.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Family Favourites
programme.desc: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from Monster Family to The Amazing Maurice.

programme.title: The Tuxedo
programme.desc: Jackie Chan is mistaken for a secret agent when a hi-tech tux turns him into a superspy. Jennifer Love Hewitt stars in a gadget-packed action comedy.

programme.title: Mousehunt
programme.desc: Lee Evans and Nathan Lane are the bumbling brothers whose plans to renovate a valuable building are thwarted by a super smart rodent. Comedy with Christopher Walken.

programme.title: Wicked
programme.desc: The Oscar-winning musical epic about the untold story of the Witches of Oz makes its debut on the big screen, starring Cynthia Erivo and Ariana Grande.

programme.title: Wicked: For Good
programme.desc: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz - for good.

programme.title: The Wizard Of Oz
programme.desc: Victor Fleming's Oscar-winning classic about a young girl, swept away from her home into the magical land of Oz. With Judy Garland, Ray Bolger and Bert Lahr.

programme.title: Free Willy
programme.desc: A wayward orphan befriends a captive killer whale, but when danger comes calling he vows to release his new pal safely into the wild. Family drama with Michael Madsen.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Beatrix Potter adaptation with James Corden voicing the mischievous rabbit whose feud with the McGregors reaches new heights.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit 2
programme.desc: Bored of life in the garden, Peter goes to the big city, where he meets shady characters and ends up creating chaos for the whole family.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The ninja turtles emerge from the sewers below to protect New York from the villainous Shredder. Hit action fun with Megan Fox.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The turtles are back battling bad guys when Shredder busts out of custody and teams up with Krang.

programme.title: The Next Karate Kid
programme.desc: Wise karate mentor Mr Miyagi meets the orphaned teenage grand-daughter of a soldier who once saved his life. As well as guiding her through the trials of high school and her first romance, he takes her to a Zen monastery to hone her martial arts skills. Adventure sequel, starring Pat Morita, Hilary Swank, Michael Ironside and Constance Towers.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: An American youngster goes to live in China with his mother, where he becomes an outsider and falls foul of the local bullies. He receives help from the kindly school caretaker, who turns out to be a kung fu master and offers to train the boy to defend himself. Martial arts drama, with Jaden Smith and Jackie Chan.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Kung fu prodigy Li Fong moves to New York City with his mother and befriends his classmate, Mia. But Connor Day, a local karate champion, provokes Li and publicly humiliates him. Li seeks guidance from his mentor, the kung fu master Mr Han, who reaches out to Daniel LaRusso, convincing the original Karate Kid to teach Li the principles of Miyagi Karate. Drama sequel, starring Jackie Chan, Ben Wang and Ralph Macchio.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: A teenager at a new school befriends a pretty girl, but her ex-boyfriend is jealous and attacks him. During one particularly bad fight, a wise old caretaker intervenes and defeats the youngster's assailants using his martial arts skills. He goes on to mentor the boy and teach him karate so he can face his enemies in a tournament. Drama, with Ralph Macchio, Pat Morita and Elisabeth Shue.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II
programme.desc: High-kicking teenager Daniel accompanies his venerable mentor Mr Miyagi when he returns to the Japanese province of Okinawa to visit his dying father. However, an old rival of Miyagi's is waiting for them, while Daniel is drawn into a vicious conflict with their enemy's own karate protege. Martial arts sequel, starring Ralph Macchio, Pat Morita and Yuji Okumoto.

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: A New England seaside town's tourist season is turned into a nightmare by a giant killer shark. The local police chief's efforts to protect the public are thwarted by the greedy mayor, forcing him to join forces with a grizzled fisherman and an enthusiastic marine biologist to hunt and kill the monster predator. Steven Spielberg's blockbusting thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Richard Dreyfuss and Robert Shaw, with an Oscar-winning score by John Williams. The film also won Academy Awards for Best Sound and Best Film Editing.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: The seaside resort of Amity is terrorised once again by a man-eating great white shark. While police chief Brody struggles to alert the townsfolk to the magnitude of the danger, a group of teenagers - including Brody's two sons - is adrift at sea in waters hunted by the shark. Director Jeannot Szwarc's thriller sequel, starring Roy Scheider, Lorraine Gary and Murray Hamilton, with John Williams once more providing the acclaimed score.

programme.title: Jaws 3
programme.desc: A shark is captured by divers and put on display in a Florida marine centre, where it ultimately dies. However, examination of the body reveals the seemingly fully-grown shark was actually a baby - and its enormous, ferocious mother soon comes looking for it. Thriller sequel, originally released in cinemas in 3D, starring Dennis Quaid, Simon MacCorkindale, Louis Gossett Jr and Bess Armstrong.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect
programme.desc: Under heavy pressure from her father, Beca reluctantly starts her first year at Barden University and gets an internship at the school radio station. She soon acquires a new circle of friends in the form of a band of misfits with a shared talent for singing, joining their a cappella group and trying to inject some much needed energy into their repertoire. Comedy, starring Anna Kendrick, Brittany Snow, Anna Camp, Rebel Wilson and Skylar Astin.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2
programme.desc: A Cappella group the Barden Bellas enjoy an unprecedented run of success, until a disastrous performance sees them banned from national competitions and beset by scandal. They attempt to turn their fortunes around and redeem their reputation by competing in the World Championships of A Cappella in Copenhagen. Comedy sequel, starring Anna Kendrick and Rebel Wilson.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: Following their win at the world championship, the now-separated Bellas (an all-female a cappella singing group) reunite for one last singing competition at an overseas USO tour. However, they face a squad who uses both instruments and voices. Final part of the blockbusting comedy trilogy, starring Anna Kendrick, Rebel Wilson and Brittany Snow.
